title.value: Abg-CoQA: Clarifying Ambiguity in Conversational Question Answering
title.justification: The paper focuses on the Abg-CoQA dataset which aims to clarify ambiguity in conversational question answering.
title.quote: In this paper, we introduce Abg-CoQA, a dataset for clarifying the ambiguity in Conversational Question Answering.

analysis.description: The paper introduces Abg-CoQA, a dataset to study and generate effective clarification questions in conversational question answering. It evaluates strong language generation models and conversational question answering models on their ability to detect ambiguities, generate clarification questions, and answer questions after clarification.

type.justification: The paper involves practical evaluations of models on a newly introduced dataset, Abg-CoQA, and reports performance metrics, indicating it is empirical.
type.quote: We evaluate strong language generation models and conversational question answering models on Abg-CoQA...

name.justification: The primary focus of the paper is to clarify ambiguity in conversational question answering systems.
name.quote: This paper aims at studying the extent to which the state of the art neural generation models can generate effective clarification questions in conversational question answering.

name.justification: The paper deals with generating clarification questions, indicating a focus on generating natural language.
name.quote: ...the state of the art neural generation models can generate effective clarification questions...

name.justification: The paper relates to dialogue systems by addressing the ability to request clarification and handle ambiguities in conversation.
name.quote: The ability to request clarification of utterance in dialogue has been extensively studied in dialogue research...

name.justification: BERT is used in the paper as a baseline model for task evaluation in conversational settings.
name.quote: ...a baseline model which has a BERT-based architecture with answer verification...

is_contributed.justification: BERT was utilized but not introduced or modified significantly in this paper.

is_executed.justification: BERT-based models were executed in the experiments as reported in the performance tables.
